title: Turkish Vegetable Borek
description: A traditional Turkish dish consisting of flaky pastry pockets filled with roasted vegetables.
instructions: Cut phyllo dough into 4 equal pieces.
Place a piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface and brush with olive oil.
Place a few pieces of roasted eggplant, red bell pepper, and zucchini in the center of the phyllo dough.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the borek with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Repeat with the remaining phyllo dough and filling.
Place the borek on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes.
